traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰς βίας τὰς πρώτας ἃς πρὸ ἐμοῦ ἐβάρυναν ἐπ᾽ αὐτούς ,
traditions.VUL: Duces autem primi , qui fúerant ante me , gravavérunt pópulum ,
traditions.KJV: But the former governors that [ had been ] before me were chargeable unto the people ,

15.english_reference: and had taken of them bread and wine , beside forty shekels of silver ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְח֨וּ מֵ הֶ֜ם בְּ לֶ֤חֶם וָ יַ֨יִן֙ אַחַר֙ כֶּֽסֶף שְׁקָלִ֣ים אַרְבָּעִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐλάβοσαν παρ᾽ αὐτῶν ἐν ἄρτοις καὶ ἐν οἴνῳ ἔσχατον ἀργύριον , δίδραχμα τεσσεράκοντα ,
traditions.VUL: et accepérunt ab eis in pane , et vino , et pecúnia , quotídie siclos quadragínta :
traditions.KJV: and had taken of them bread and wine , beside forty shekels of silver ;

15.english_reference: yea , even their servants bare rule over the people :

traditions.WLC: גַּ֥ם נַעֲרֵי הֶ֖ם שָׁלְט֣וּ עַל הָ עָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ἐκτετιναγμένοι αὐτῶν ἐξουσιάζονται ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν ·
traditions.VUL: sed et minístri eórum depressérunt pópulum .
traditions.KJV: yea , even their servants bare rule over the people :

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲנִי֙ לֹא עָשִׂ֣יתִי כֵ֔ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγὼ οὐκ ἐποίησα οὕτως
traditions.VUL: Ego autem non feci ita
traditions.KJV: but so did not I ,

15.english_reference: because of the fear of God .

traditions.WLC: מִ פְּנֵ֖י יִרְאַ֥ת אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ προσώπου φόβου θεοῦ .
traditions.VUL: propter timórem Dei :
traditions.KJV: because of the fear of God .

16.english_reference: Yea , also I continued in the work of this wall ,

traditions.WLC: וְ֠ גַם בִּ מְלֶ֜אכֶת הַ חוֹמָ֤ה הַ זֹּאת֙ הֶחֱזַ֔קְתִּי
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν ἔργῳ τοῦ τείχους τούτων οὐκ ἐκράτησα ,
traditions.VUL: quin pótius in ópere muri ædificávi ,
traditions.KJV: Yea , also I continued in the work of this wall ,

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׂדֶ֖ה לֹ֣א קָנִ֑ינוּ
traditions.LXX: ἀγρὸν οὐκ ἐκτησάμην ·
traditions.VUL: et agrum non emi ,
traditions.KJV: neither bought we any land :

16.english_reference: and all my servants [ were ] gathered thither unto the work .

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל נְעָרַ֔ י קְבוּצִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם עַל הַ מְּלָאכָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ πάντες οἱ συνηγμένοι ἐκεῖ ἐπὶ τὸ ἔργον .
traditions.VUL: et omnes púeri mei congregáti ad opus erant .
traditions.KJV: and all my servants [ were ] gathered thither unto the work .

17.english_reference: Moreover [ there were ] at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ יְּהוּדִ֨ים וְ הַ סְּגָנִ֜ים מֵאָ֧ה וַ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אִ֗ישׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἑκατὸν καὶ πεντήκοντα ἄνδρες ,
traditions.VUL: Iudǽi quoque et magistrátus centum quinquagínta viri ,
traditions.KJV: Moreover [ there were ] at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers ,

17.english_reference: beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that [ are ] about us .

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ בָּאִ֥ים אֵלֵ֛י נוּ מִן הַ גּוֹיִ֥ם אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵ֖י נוּ עַל שֻׁלְחָנִֽ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρχόμενοι πρὸς ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν τῶν κύκλῳ ἡμῶν ἐπὶ τράπεζάν μου .
traditions.VUL: et qui veniébant ad nos de géntibus , quæ in circúitu nostro sunt , in mensa mea erant .
traditions.KJV: beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that [ are ] about us .

18.english_reference: Now [ that ] which was prepared [ for me ] daily [ was ] one ox [ and ] six choice sheep ;

traditions.WLC: וַ אֲשֶׁר֩ הָיָ֨ה נַעֲשֶׂ֜ה לְ י֣וֹם אֶחָ֗ד שׁ֣וֹר אֶחָ֞ד צֹ֠אן שֵׁשׁ בְּרֻר֤וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦν γινόμενον εἰς ἡμέραν μίαν μόσχος εἷς , καὶ πρόβατα ἐκλεκτὰ
traditions.VUL: Parabátur autem mihi per dies síngulos bos unus , aríetes sex elécti ,
traditions.KJV: Now [ that ] which was prepared [ for me ] daily [ was ] one ox [ and ] six choice sheep ;

18.english_reference: also fowls were prepared for me ,

traditions.WLC: וְ צִפֳּרִים֙ נַֽעֲשׂוּ לִ֔ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ χίμαρος ἐγίνοντό μοι ,
traditions.VUL: excéptis volatílibus ,
traditions.KJV: also fowls were prepared for me ,

18.english_reference: and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine :

traditions.WLC: וּ בֵ֨ין עֲשֶׂ֧רֶת יָמִ֛ים בְּ כָל יַ֖יִן לְ הַרְבֵּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον δέκα ἡμερῶν ἐν πᾶσιν οἶνος τῷ πλήθει ·
traditions.VUL: et inter dies decem vina divérsa , et ália multa tribuébam :
traditions.KJV: and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine :

18.english_reference: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor ,

traditions.WLC: וְ עִם זֶ֗ה לֶ֤חֶם הַ פֶּחָה֙ לֹ֣א בִקַּ֔שְׁתִּי
traditions.LXX: καὶ σὺν τούτοις ἄρτους τῆς βίας οὐκ ἐζήτησα ,
traditions.VUL: ínsuper et annónas ducátus mei non quæsívi :
traditions.KJV: yet for all this required not I the bread of the governor ,

18.english_reference: because the bondage was heavy upon this people .

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי כָֽבְדָ֥ה הָ עֲבֹדָ֖ה עַל הָ עָ֥ם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι βαρεῖα ἡ δουλία ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον .
traditions.VUL: valde enim attenuátus erat pópulus .
traditions.KJV: because the bondage was heavy upon this people .

19.english_reference: Think upon me , my God , for good ,

traditions.WLC: זָכְרָ ה לִּ֥ י אֱלֹהַ֖ י לְ טוֹבָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: μνήσθητί μου ὁ θεὸς εἰς ἀγαθὸν
traditions.VUL: Meménto mei Deus meus in bonum ,
traditions.KJV: Think upon me , my God , for good , [ according ]

19.english_reference: [ according ] to all that I have done for this people .

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֖יתִי עַל הָ עָ֥ם הַ זֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησα τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ .
traditions.VUL: secúndum ómnia quæ feci pópulo huic .
traditions.KJV: to all that I have done for this people .
